name: Enjoying Life
overview: Scripture reveals that true enjoyment of life is found in the presence of God, where joy is full and lasting, as Psalms 16:11 affirms. Believers are called to rejoice in each day the Lord has made (Psalms 118:24) and to embrace a joyful heart, which benefits both soul and body (Proverbs 17:22). Ecclesiastes highlights that finding satisfaction in daily labor and the simple blessings of eating and drinking is a gift from God, encouraging a life marked by rejoicing and doing good (Ecclesiastes 2:24; 3:12; 5:18). Thus, enjoying life is a God-ordained portion, rooted in gratitude and the recognition of His provision.
